description: This file defines the interface for an IPC client in the Rialto project, including accessor and client interfaces with methods for obtaining communication channels, creating closures, and RPC controllers.

classes.name: IIpcClientAccessor
classes.description: Accessor class providing singleton access to the IIpcClient instance.

classes.name: IIpcClient
classes.description: Interface defining IPC client operations such as obtaining communication channels and creating RPC-related objects.

methods.name: IIpcClientAccessor::instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the IIpcClientAccessor.

methods.name: IIpcClient::getChannel
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the IPC channel used for communication.

methods.name: IIpcClient::createBlockingClosure
methods.description: Creates and returns a blocking closure for RPC stubs.

methods.name: IIpcClient::createRpcController
methods.description: Creates and returns an RPC controller for use with RPC stubs.
